subject: DI02000171

body.en:
Understand the idea

Three-phase uses three same-frequency alternating voltages displaced by120electrical degrees;single-phase uses one alternating phase supply.

Explanation and application

  • Compare conductor arrangement,load suitability,power pulsation and rotating-field capability.Single-phase is common for smaller loads;three-phase is useful for balanced power transfer and many motors.
  • Abalanced sinusoidal three-phase load has constant total instantaneous real power,although each phase power pulsates at2f.Unbalance/distortion removes this simple guarantee.
  • Three-phase is not three times the frequency and does not imply three times a stated line voltage.The result depends on line/phase definitions and connection.
  • Classify the load connection as star ordelta,and the load/supply as balanced orunbalanced before applying√3relations.
What is balanced load?

Three equal phase impedances in both magnitude and angle at the operating frequency,not just equal labelled resistances.

Understand the idea

Three equal windings displaced by120electrical degrees encounter a common rotating magnetic field and generate three shifted EMFs.

Explanation and application

  • Construction:provide magnetic poles/rotating field and three comparable phase windings with identified starts/finishes;electrical displacement is not automatically the mechanical angle in a multi-pole machine.
  • For the declared RYBsequence:eR=Em sinθ,eY=Em sin(θ−120°),eB=Em sin(θ+120°).Their peak magnitudes and frequencies are equal.
  • The successive phase waveforms reach corresponding points T/3apart;at50Hzthis is6.66667ms.The instantaneous sum eR+eY+eB=0for the balanced set.
  • The zero sum is a vector/instantaneous relation,not permission to short the three phase terminals together.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Supply balance and load balance describe different properties and must both be checked.

Explanation and application

  • Phase sequence is the order in which phases reach corresponding positive-going points.RYBand RBYare opposite sequences under the stated labels.
  • Balanced supply has equal phase magnitudes and120°separation at the same frequency.Unbalanced supply has unequal magnitudes and/or incorrect angular spacing.
  • Balanced load has identical phase impedances at the operating frequency,including both magnitude and angle.Equal resistance alone is insufficient if phase reactances differ.
  • Changing sequence reverses the rotating-field direction and can reverse motor direction.Physical phase changes require qualified personnel,isolated/de-energised equipment and approved procedures.
  • Unbalanced loads can cause unequal currents and star-point displacement;neutral adequacy and actual voltage ratings matter.Do not apply a balanced shortcut to an unbalanced network.

  • Balancedloadનીphaseimpedancesoperatingfrequencyપરmagnitude/angleબંનેમાંસમાનહોય.Equalresistanceએકલુંપૂરતુંનથીજોપ્રતિક્રિયાંશજુદાહોય.

  • Unbalancedloadથીunequalcurrents/star-pointdisplacementથઈશકે.Neutraladequacy/actualratingsજરૂરીછે.Unbalancednetworkમાંbalancedshortcutનલો.

Understand the idea

Line voltage is measured between two line conductors;phase voltage is across one phase winding or load element.

Explanation and application

  • Line current flows in a supply line;phase current flows through one load/winding phase.The terms are defined by location,not by which value is larger.
  • In star,a phase load lies between a line and the star point;in delta,it lies directly between two lines.Identify actual meter terminals before selecting a formula.
  • All V/Ivalues in the following power calculations are RMS.Line-to-neutral is not meaningful if no accessible/reference neutral exists without an approved measurement arrangement.

Understand the idea

Explanation and application

  • Construction:connect three identified load phases to one common point;bring out neutral only when the trainer/system specifies it.Do not confuse neutral with protective earth.
  • Each line feeds exactly its own phase branch,so IL=Iphby topology.The neutral return,if present,carries the phasor sum of the phase currents.
  • For balanced RYBvoltages VRN=Vp∠0°,VYN=Vp∠−120°,VBN=Vp∠120°.VRY=VRN−VYN=Vp(3/2+j√3/2)=√3Vp∠30°.
  • Thus VL=√3Vphand line voltage leads the corresponding phase voltage30°for this sequence/reference.The other line voltages follow at−120°spacing.
  • Balanced phase currents cancel in the neutral:IN=0.Unbalanced four-wire loads may have nonzero IN;unbalanced three-wire star loads can shift their star point and change individual phase voltages.
  • For a balanced sinusoidal load:P=3VphIphcosφ=√3VLILcosφ;Q=√3VLILsinφ;|S|=√3VLIL.These common-φshortcuts are not general unbalanced-load formulas.

Explanation and application

  • Construction:connect one load between R/Y,one between Y/B,and one between B/Rwith declared voltage/current directions.Adelta has no central neutral point.
  • Each branch is directly across a line pair,so Vph=VLby topology,including an unbalanced delta.The line current is a phasor difference of its adjacent branch currents.
  • For balanced branch currents IRY=Iph∠−φand IBR=Iph∠(120°−φ),IR=IRY−IBR=√3Iph∠(−30°−φ).
  • Thus IL=√3Iphand the line current lags its corresponding branch current30°under these RYBdirections.This is not an extra30°power-factor lag relative to the appropriate voltage.
  • Total balanced power again equals3VphIphcosφ=√3VLILcosφ.With unbalanced branches,use actual branch powers and vector KCLrather than one common current/pf.
  • At the same line voltage and identical fixed phase impedances,delta places√3times the star phase voltage across each phase and draws3times the star line current.Power is3times only under those same-impedance conditions.

Aim and instruments

Instrument selection

  • Use the approved circuit-specific instruments:generator/CROfor waveform work;isolated source,rated load and appropriate ACV/I/real-power instruments for power circuits.Check manual,ranges,leads and component ratings.
  • The source lists mains-rated variacs/banks;these are supervised laboratory resources,not student DIYinstructions.Avariac does not provide isolation.

Connections and model

Use a guarded balanced three-phase load trainer in star;use its designated neutral only,never protective earth as neutral.

Procedure

  1. Instructor verifies source balance,phase identification,load equality/ratings and all de-energised meter connections before authorising energisation.
  2. Record all available line voltages/currents and the corresponding phase quantities rather than assuming a single phase represents an unbalanced set.
  3. Compare VL/Vphwith√3and IL/Iphwith1;record neutral current when an approved neutral path exists.Explain any unbalance.
  4. Keep actual readings,supply condition,instrument ranges and uncertainty separate from the computed expected reference.
  5. On a discrepancy,stop and check de-energised connections,model assumptions and instrument suitability;do not increase voltage to force agreement.
  6. After approved shutdown,verify safe capacitor discharge and leave the trainer in its required state.Report only work genuinely performed.

Expected calculations and interpretation

The balanced numerical models in Unit4are reference calculations only;actual meter readings remain blank until performed.

Safe fault finding

Stop on abnormal current,unbalance,overheating or lost neutral.Protective devices are not substitutes for correct dead checks.Nohot reconnection is permitted.

Essential precautions

  • Only qualified-supervised energised power-lab work is intended.Never defeat protective earth,connect ammeters across the supply,short phases or change wiring while energised.
